title: Damavik canonical event
description: The frozen event schema. Every sensor, rule, store query, API response and UI view speaks only this. Unknown fields are permitted for forward compatibility but are ignored by scoring; unknown `type` values are stored as `sensor.meta` with `meta.original_type` preserved. The authoritative validator is `brain/damavik/schema.py::validate_event` — this document mirrors it and `tests/test_schema.py` fails if the two drift.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Present on every record Damavik writes.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision. Sensors may send epoch seconds/ms; the brain coerces.

host.description: Machine identifier. Defaults to the hostname; overridable via `host_id` in config.

seq.description: Monotonic per-sensor sequence number. Survives sensor restarts within a boot.

boot_id.description: Boot identifier from the OS. Lets the brain detect that `seq` restarted.

sensor_id.description: Which sensor emitted this event, e.g. `linux-ebpf`, `py-proc`, `osquery`.

score.description: Filled by the brain's scorer, never by a sensor.

rule.description: Id of the rule that fired, if any.

proc.description: Process context. Present on `proc.exec` and attached to related events.

exe.description: Absolute path to the executable image.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex. A file too large to hash is omitted rather than partially hashed.

start_ms.description: Epoch ms of process start, when the sensor knows it.

src.description: Source IP literal (v4 or v6, including IPv4-mapped).

rtype.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, TXT, CNAME.

root.description: Registrable domain, computed by the brain.

cves.description: Advisory ids matched against the local OSV mirror.

yara.description: Matched YARA rule names, emitted by the sensor.

meta.description: Derived and auxiliary fields. The enricher writes here; rules read from here. Also holds `original_type` for events whose type the brain did not recognise, `kind`/`action` for `sys.event`, and drop counters for `sensor.meta`.
